summary: Latency-sensitive smoke test of website builder MVP. All 6 backend CRUD endpoints pass (create/list/get/put/delete + 404 unknown). Frontend builder shell mounts, most flows work: block insertion via double-click, cards row insert, element selection with inspector id, color apply (verified via screenshot - hero background changed to #2563eb), code mode toggle with head-html textarea, export dropdown showing standalone & zip options, Google Font input adds Roboto and injects <link> to fonts.googleapis.com, import panel scan opens sections modal, project save to backend succeeds.
passed: POST /api/projects returns 200 with id and full payload
GET /api/projects returns array sorted with id/name/updated_at
GET /api/projects/{id} returns full project incl. elements
PUT /api/projects/{id} updates fields and refreshes updated_at
DELETE /api/projects/{id} returns {ok:true} and subsequent GET returns 404
TopBar shows Design/Code toggle + Import/Export/Save/Open buttons
Click canvas element selects it (inspector shows element id e.g. el_yoirs6bs)
Apply background color visually changes selected element (verified via screenshot)
mode-code toggle renders editable head-html textarea
export-btn opens dropdown with export-standalone and export-zip
import-btn + import-scan-btn opens imported-sections modal after scanning simple HTML

failed.issue: open-btn click intermittently times out immediately after save-btn or export-btn interactions; likely because a Sonner toast or lingering dropdown overlay covers the button briefly. Open button IS present in DOM (verified in screenshot).
failed.evidence: Playwright: waiting for locator [data-testid="open-btn"] Timeout 5000ms; screenshot shows Open button clearly visible in top bar.

action_items: Optional UX: ensure Sonner toast / Export dropdown does not overlap top-bar buttons (or dismiss automatically) so Open remains reliably clickable right after Save/Export. Not a blocker for first finish.
